FAST.description: Extremely clear, low risk, mechanical, very limited scope; latency is the priority.

SMALL.description: Clear requirement, limited scope, one or a few related files, no architecture impact, low regression risk.

NORMAL.description: Normal feature development, several related files, moderate business logic, manageable regression risk.

DIFFICULT.description: Subtle business logic, hard debugging, permissions, integration behaviour, data integrity, concurrency, complex migrations, architectural decisions, high ambiguity, or previous implementation failure. Raise effort to high when reasoning complexity or risk justifies it.

Kimi K3.description: Not a default implementation model. Selective use when a task particularly benefits from large repository context, long-horizon reasoning, or broad codebase analysis. Not for routine implementation where Kimi K2.7 Code is sufficient.
